text: The Director, Arts and Culture, Economic Development and Culture will provide an overview of current partnerships with other cities and countries, including any memorandums of understanding currently in place. On March 10, 2020, the Economic and Community Development Committee, on the recommendation of the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee (Item FA2.6), requested the General Manager, Economic Development and Culture, to provide an overview of current partnerships with other cities and countries, including any Memorandums of Understanding currently in place.

The Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee requested the Director, Arts and Culture Services to report back to the Toronto Francophone Affairs Advisory Committee with more details about the partnership with Marseilles, as well as with information about partnerships between Toronto and other Canadian Cities.
